name: D.U.D.S.
teaser: 7.62x51mm NATO Depleted Uranium Discarding Sabot cartridge. What more do I have to say?
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
Adds in a new cartridge chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO. Higher tier than M993, providing better armor piercing, damage, and insane velocity at the cost of a slight recoil increase and prohibitive expense. Sold at Peacekeeper 4 for $97 a pop.

For maximum Cold War gone spicy hot vibes I’d stick these hush puppies in Massivesoft’s M14 mod.

Bit of a meme and a rather underwhelming for the cost as I was bored while watching Oxide’s recent videos on said round. Price, trade level, and stats are configurable so have fun making it actually balanced.

Model is by me, edited from the 7.62 M993 model by BSG
